duration: Duration of item wording on screen in seconds since start of scan.
event_type: If a real-time fMRI study, whether this probe triggered by a brain event or a timeout.

aff.description: How positive or negative you felt while having these thoughts.
aff.question_wording: How positive or negative were you feeling?

arou.description: Activation (or arousal) includes feelings of energy linked to emotion.
arou.question_wording: How activated or energized were you feeling?

att.description: Determine whether your attention was on your thoughts (mental) or something tangible on your body or the environment (physical) or if you are unable to recall thinking about anything (mind blank).
att.question_wording: Were you more focused on your thoughts (mental) or sensing the world or your body (phsysical)? (or if your mind was blank press the 0 key)

conf.description: How accurately you were able to remember and categorize your thoughts by answering the questions, and how strongly you believe they reflect your last thought.
conf.question_wording: How confident are you about your ratings for this trial?

delib.description: Think about whether you directed your attention to a certain task or thoughts with purpose or if your thoughts popped into your mind without intending to do so.

eng.description: Think about how easy it was to pull yourself away from your thoughts at the onset of the probe.
eng.question_wording: How easy was it to disengage from your thoughts?

fut.description: Determine where your thoughts were located in time.
fut.question_wording: Were your thoughts oriented towards the future?

image.description: Think about whether your thoughts took the form of images.

ling.description: Were your thoughts manifesting as a voice in your head or were your thoughts oriented as words or using language?

mvmt.description: Think about the last few seconds before the questions popped up and whether you were focused on one thought for an extended period of time (unmoving) or if your thoughts were drifting from one thing to another without focusing on any single thought for long (freely moving).

past.description: Determine where your thoughts were located in time.
past.question_wording: Were your thoughts oriented towards the past?

ppl.description: Think about whether your thoughts were focused on others, or matters related to others.

self.description: Think about whether your thoughts were focused on yourself, or matters related to you.

offset: Offset of wording from screen in cumulative seconds.
onset: Onset of item wording on screen in cumulative seconds since start of scan.
response: Response made by participant on the scale
trial: The number ID of experience sampling probe in ascending order.
